scope: provider-free Bun embedded-agent research; not a stable adapter registry

overall.reason: Transport and packaging probes exist, but no candidate has passed the language-owned semantic conformance corpus, real auth/billing evidence, process-containment requirements, and all candidate-specific portability gates.

combinedInstall.note: This deliberately broad research workspace contains all four candidates and is not a proposed production dependency set.

typecheck.reason: Without skipLibCheck, the pinned third-party declaration graph failed on undici-types/MCP globals and OMP declarations (models.json, fastembed, DOM and internal interface conflicts). Lab source itself is still checked strictly.

verification.packageSmokeIsolation: Each compiled artifact is copied to a new temporary directory and started with only HOME and PATH; candidate-declared sidecars are copied explicitly.

authAndBilling.claim: SDK delegates authentication and billing to its spawned Codex CLI; this lab supplied neither credentials nor a login.

transport.implementation: The SDK manages a Codex CLI JSONL subprocess. runtimeImageUtf8 is config.developer_instructions and taskEnvelope is the runStreamed input.
transport.cancellation: AbortSignal is forwarded through TurnOptions; provider-free cancellation settles as cancelled.
transport.terminal: turn.completed or turn.failed is mandatory; EOF otherwise throws.
transport.providerFreeEvidence: The actual SDK was run against test/fixtures/fake-codex.ts, an executable JSONL fixture; no model or credential path was touched.

packaging.reproduction: Copy dist/codex-lab to an empty directory and run it with HOME set there and PATH=/usr/bin:/bin.
packaging.observedError: Unable to locate Codex CLI binaries. Ensure @openai/codex is installed with optional dependencies.
packaging.reason: The compiled Bun file does not carry or extract the optional platform Codex binary.

blockers: The public SDK surface does not expose strict equivalents for --ephemeral, --ignore-user-config, or --ignore-rules; a private CODEX_HOME can isolate home config but not repository rules.
Descendant process containment and kill/settlement behavior are not proven.
The platform binary must be embedded/extracted or shipped as an explicit verified sidecar.
Language-owned semantic conformance and real auth/billing probes remain unrun.

package.name: @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk
package.licenseSummary: Anthropic copyright; use subject to linked Legal Agreements; requires legal review rather than treating it as an SPDX grant.

authAndBilling.claim: Current SDK documentation supports Anthropic API/cloud-provider credential paths; this lab found no evidence that an ordinary Claude subscription is a portable SDK billing path.

transport.implementation: runtimeImageUtf8 appends to the claude_code preset while taskEnvelope remains the query prompt. settingSources, skills and plugins are empty; strict MCP is enabled; sessions are not persisted.
transport.cancellation: An invocation AbortSignal drives the SDK AbortController and Query.close() always runs.
transport.terminal: A result:* SDK message is mandatory; EOF otherwise throws.
transport.providerFreeEvidence: A fake Query async stream exercised event collection, cancellation, closure and terminal validation without invoking Claude.

packaging.evidence: The copied artifact started in an empty directory and reported extracted=true; the SDK's documented BunFS extraction path found the bundled executable.

blockers: No subscription-auth path was demonstrated; API/cloud auth and billing must be recorded explicitly.
Descendant process containment and kill/settlement behavior are not proven.
Only darwin-arm64 packaging was tested; release matrix and license review remain.

authAndBilling.claim: The plan selects OpenRouter and declares openrouter-api-key-or-oauth auth with OpenRouter as billing owner. No credential was read and no model call was made.

transport.implementation: In-memory auth, model, settings and session stores are combined with a ResourceLoader whose exact system prompt is runtimeImageUtf8 and whose ambient agents/extensions/prompts/skills/themes are empty. taskEnvelope is the session prompt.
transport.ambientIsolation: resource-discovery isolated; process environment not isolated
transport.cancellation: AbortSignal invokes AgentSession.abort(); unsubscribe and dispose always run.
transport.terminal: agent_end is mandatory; settlement without it throws.
transport.providerFreeEvidence: The real model registry/resource loader is built and a fake session boundary exercises prompt, events, cancellation and disposal.

sidecars.reason: The package resolves metadata at runtime; a pure copied executable failed with ENOENT for dist/package.json.

blockers: The isolated default coding-agent SDK does not itself supply a complete generic subagent substrate; an explicit extension/profile and semantic corpus are required.
The in-process session surface has no per-session environment boundary; the SDK and spawned tools can observe the host process environment unless the adapter owns an isolated worker/process.
additionalDirectories has no equivalent in the tested session options and needs a declared compatibility policy.
Real OpenRouter auth, billing, cancellation, rate-limit and provider failure behavior remain unproven.
Packaging currently needs a metadata sidecar and only darwin-arm64 was tested.

authAndBilling.claim: The lab marks both as harness-managed because no primary-source, provider-free proof of the intended account/subscription route was completed.

transport.implementation: createAgentSession receives runtimeImageUtf8 as its only system prompt, taskEnvelope separately, isolated Settings, empty contexts/rules/skills/templates/slash commands, no UI/MCP/LSP/IRC, extension discovery disabled, and a restricted tool list including task.
transport.ambientIsolation: resource-discovery isolated; process environment not isolated
transport.cancellation: AbortSignal invokes AgentSession.abort(reason); unsubscribe and async dispose always run.
transport.terminal: agent_end is mandatory; settlement without it throws.
transport.providerFreeEvidence: Real OMP settings/session options are built and a fake session boundary exercises prompt, events, cancellation and disposal.

sidecars.reason: The pure compiled artifact failed to load the platform N-API addon.

externalized.reason: Bun compilation otherwise fails to resolve this optional legacy compatibility import; extension discovery is disabled in the tested profile.

blockers: The observed Bun 1.3.5 is below the package's declared >=1.3.14 support floor; import/tests/compile succeeding is not a supported-runtime qualification.
The in-process session surface has no per-session environment boundary; the SDK and spawned tools can observe the host process environment unless the adapter owns an isolated worker/process.
additionalDirectories has no equivalent in the tested session options and needs a declared compatibility policy.
Authentication, billing and real cancellation/failure behavior are not proven.
The large platform native sidecar and optional legacy import need a release policy and cross-platform matrix.
Language-owned subagent semantic conformance remains unrun.

recover: Injected SDK factory/query seams and dynamic imports
Typed event streams with separate stdout/stderr evidence
Hostile installer tests for shell syntax, dry run, unsafe labels, runtime absence, checksums, archive roots, escaping symlinks and hardlinks
Package bin/main/exports checks and an explicit opt-in smoke harness
reject: Automatic skill installation/loading and language-specific canonicalPrompt/command semantics
Ambient process.env, user/project configuration, or credential fallback as benchmark inputs
SDK selection implicitly changing billing policy
Single-child cancellation and flattening to exit 143 without normalized settlement evidence
Success without a provider-declared terminal event
Unbounded stream forwarding without backpressure/lifecycle ownership
